notes.title: New game Arctic Drive challenges you to survive in the frozen wilderness!
notes.content:
[h2]Our New Game: Arctic Drive – A 1-4 player survival road trip game is coming soon![/h2][p]Hey everyone!
We’re excited to finally share what we’ve been working on next: [/p][p][b]Arctic Drive[/b] is a survival road trip game in a procedurally generated frozen wasteland. Drive and upgrade your off-road vehicle alone or with up to 3 friends, scavenge for fuel, food, and parts, and survive hunger, thirst, and sub-zero temperatures.[/p][p]It's a game that may test your friendship in harsh conditions :) [/p]

[h2]Wishlist Arctic Drive[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4009490/Arctic_Drive/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]1–4 player co-op[/b]: Coordinate roles, share supplies, revive teammates, and keep the convoy rolling.
[*][b]Immersive simulation[/b]: Cars and objects have simulated physics. If you can pick it up, you can cram it in the car or trailer. Drift through blinding snow, then step out to explore and haul loot.[*][b]Procedurally generated world[/b]: Fresh routes, point of interests, and challenges every run.
[*][b]Vehicle customization and repair[/b]: Engines, tires, decorations, heaters, chains, and more.
[*][b]Survival systems[/b]: Manage hunger, thirst, and body temperature. Hunt or forage for food, melt snow for water, and make a fire or let the engines on to avoid hypothermia.
[*][b]Cross-platform play[/b]: Windows, macOS, and Linux. No one gets left out in the cold!
[/list]


Stay sharp!
Clem[/p]

notes.title: Puropu Defense Squad launches with a 20% discount!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to announce that Puropu Defense Squad is officially live on Steam! 🎉 After 2 years of hard work, sleepless nights, and countless rounds of playtesting (and coffeety), we can finally share this chaotic, action-packed journey with you.

We’re incredibly grateful for your support, and we can't wait to hear about your favorite characters, most chaotic moments, and epic victories. Be sure to join the community, share your feedback, and let us know what you’d like to see in future updates.

This isn't your typical tower defense game—it's a [b]co-op action-strategy hybrid[/b] where you and your friends can control sentient Props with unique abilities to fend off waves of relentless human invaders. Build, strategize, and unleash mayhem together!

Why should you dive in?

[list]
[*] [b]Playable heroes:[/b] Choose from a roster of quirky Props, each with distinct abilities and customizable talent trees.
[*] [b]Four challenging modes:[/b] Tackle Normal, Elite, Heroic, or push your limits in the Infinite Challenge.
[*] [b]Multiplayer madness:[/b] Team up with up to 3 friends in cross-platform PC/Mac/Linux co-op.
[*] [b]A lot more to come![/b] More maps, enemies, heroes, and we'll be coming to consoles soon! Check out the content to come in the roadmap below.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/03cda47447cdc3294d9879df4b62a1bde1264f41.png[/img]

🎮 Not sure yet? Check out the game and download the demo on our Steam page.

Happy defending!
P.S. Stay tuned for console releases in early 2025—[b]this is just the beginning ;)[/b]

notes.title: V0.997 - Exploits fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have seen many reports of people exploiting the maps and getting in places where they could not be caught. We tried to come up with many solution, which is to remove the Grapple skill completly since it brakes the game and it's not easy to repair.

We added some other things in there too, here's the complete list!
- Removed Grappling Hook skill from the game
- Improved maps to avoid exploits
- Fixed some words in the Russian translation
- Added a new Cyrillic font to fix some characters not showing on the screen
- Updated networking code

Stay tuned for some new maps and content by the end of the year! ;)

Thank you for your support, it warms our heart <3

notes.title: v0.4.992 - Gameplay improvements and balancing
notes.content:
Hello props and hunters!

With this update, we wanted to address your feedbacks about the hunter being too powerful. So we made many changes, which we hope will balance things out and make props great again!

[list]
[*] Hunter: reworked shoot visual effect and animation
[*] Increased range of Hunter shot
[*] Increased shooting cooldown
[*] Increased time needed to capture
[*] Reduced time to break the link
[*] Increased time before goal opens
[*] Balanced timings on many maps to make the hiding phase a bit more dynamic
[*] +10 pts + 2 pts per hunter for props hiding until the end of the round
[*] Taunt is really more noticeable (increase range and volume)
[*] Fixed: Hot/Cold bar is not disabled as it should
[/list]

- Stun: Unlock at level 8

notes.title: Run Prop, Run! is now available FOR FREE!
notes.content:
Hello prop hunters!

We're incredibly excited to be sharing this news and making our transition into a free to play design.
We also know you will have a ton of questions; many will be answered below but you can always ask us directly in the comments here or on Discord :)

[h2][b]FAQ[/b][/h2]
[b]Why going free?[/b]
We love this game, and we've put thousands of hours into making it something we can be truly proud of. We also want to make sure there are always people playing, and full lobbies are readily available for anyone who's checking out the game for the first time. 

[b]What about everyone who purchased the game before the 24th?[/b]
Everyone who bought RPR will get a [b]Supporter Pack[/b] which is our way of saying thank you, and making sure the OG's get something amazing for their support. [b]The pack will include: 
1)Golden Default Gun Hunter Skin
    2)Golden Glue Gun Hunter Skin
    3)Golden Rubiscube Prop Skin
    4)Golden SteamPunk Hat[/b]

Additionally, supporters will continue to have full access to the Bring Your Own Prop feature and the store. Going forward, these options will be a one time purchase to obtain.

[b]When's it happening?[/b]
The official change is July 24th at 9AM EST!

[b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Run%20Prop%2C%20Run! ]We'll have creators live all day on the 24th! Click here to see! [/url][/b]

We hope everyone is as excited as we are for this change, and again any questions can be directed to the #bugs-feedback channel [url=https://discord.gg/YsUJ3d3uJT]on Discord[/url] where you can leave your suggestions for our dev team.

Stay sharp!
Clem

notes.title: MAJOR Update incoming! Grab your key to play!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are about to release a new map called [b]Midnight Town[/b]! Where spooky things can happen and props could emerge from forgotten worlds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39226759/be1d5938094cc9f1668c408550474a93e840dbe9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39226759/4fee65f9b75e5d47993419a0dd4da6a0632e7d5c.png[/img]

What do we plan next?
We are working full throttle to prepare the upcoming launch of the game and we will keep releasing new content to the beta test version every week so we can gather feedback to make the best game possible (we also love to see your reactions!). Hang out [url=https://discord.gg/YsUJ3d3uJT]on our Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/RunPropRun]Twitter[/url] to stay tuned!

What else did we add in the last few updates?
[list]
[*] [b]PROGRESSION:[/b]Level up and earns new customizations by just playing!
[*] [b]CUSTOMIZATION:[/b] Added Hunter customizations with dozens of skins, hats, mustaches and so much more!
[*] [b]Auto-Taunt:[/b] As a prop, when you stand still, you will taunt every 20sec.
[*] [b]New Decoy Skill:[/b] Make a prop move randomly for 10sec. Use it to draw the attention of a hunter and make your move!
[*] [b]New Speed Boosts[/b] bonus to pickup on the maps: Step on it to give yourself a instant movement speed boost of 100% for 1.5s.
[*] [b]Capture time major change:[/b] length adapted to the size of props: Small 2.5sec / Medium 3sec / Big 3.5sec
[*] PLAYER LIMIT INCREASED TO 12! (Default is still 8)
[/list]

We hope you like what you see! We have many other surprises and new things to show, see ya in game!

Dave & Clem

notes.title: Many new things were added in the last 2 weeks!
notes.content:
Are we mid-January already?! We added so many things into the game it was hard to keep track, so here's a little summary of what has been added and changed:

[list]
[*] Custom Games: Now you can change the length of every phases in the game. We will add new parameters soon like number of hunters, proxy meter ON/OFF, etc. Tell us what you would like to modify and we'll add it!
[*] New Taunts: Pick your favorite sound effect and press F to blast it around the level
[*] Podium: Bragging time!
[*] Capture cam: See the hunter who dared to capture you!
[/list]

We buffed both skills SpeedBoost and Smokescreen to make them more viable against Dive and also to offer another way to escape as a prop. Tell us what you think!
[list]
[*] Buff SpeedBoost: Now boost your speed by 100% for 1.5s.
[*] Buff Smokescreen: Now the smoke lasts longer, and the effect is bigger. 
[*] Dive is now way less powerful
[*] Bugfix: Taunts should now always play
[*] Goal zone: the zone is now taller, so you can jump right above the zone and still escape
[*] PropFarm: Can't get on the big tree anymore
[*] Quality-of-life improvements all over the place
[*] New sound effects, voices, visual effects on props, in maps and menus
[*] Dozens of fixes and small improvements
[/list]

We are currently working on a new map (and props!) as well as a little surprise ;)

Stay hidden, stay sharp, stay tuned!
Clem

notes.content:

What is [i]Run Prop, Run![/i] ?
[list]
